decisions.reason: Because the firm is growing, hiring, and explicitly expanding organic lines, this close-to-core product is likely to be retained despite somewhat weaker website prominence, which suggests only moderate uncertainty rather than clear underperformance.

This organic, convenience-oriented snack fits the firm's stated strategic direction and core capabilities well, and with industry growth and organisational slack there is little pressure to remove it quickly.

As a close extension of the established salami range with visible website support, it is likely to stay unless results disappoint, but it is slightly less protected than the organic products because it is less central to the firm's stated future focus.
